mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,task_id,plan_revision,revision,created_by,created_at,updated_at,classification FROM task_plan_head WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operationName} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,task_id,decision_id,operation_id,target_plan_revision,target_plan_sha256, basis_task_revision,resulting_task_revision,resulting_plan_revision,decision,from_status,to_status, expected_revision,resulting_revision,reason,request_json,baseline_manifest,baseline_sha256,dependency_authorizations, receipt_json,receipt_sha256,authority_grant,authority_revision,auth_epoch,governance_epoch,schema_version, schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification FROM task_plan_decision WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.tenant_id,t.project_id,t.task_id,t.task_revision,t.profile_revision,t.snapshot_id,t.template_version,t.agent_release_id, t.plan_revision,t.parent_revision,t.reason,t.content_sha256,t.created_by,t.created_at,t.classification, v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id,v.entity_kind AS registered_kind,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256 FROM task_revision t JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND v.version_id=t.task_revision WHERE t.project_id=#{projectId} AND t.task_id=#{taskId} AND t.task_revision=#{taskRevision} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_id=#{operationId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='task.input_draft.saved' AND payload->>'$.operation_id'=#{operationId}

SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{ownerId} AND action='task.read' AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.member_id,m.user_id,m.status,m.valid_from,m.valid_to,m.revision FROM tenant_member m WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND m.user_id > #{after} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_binding i WHERE i.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND i.user_id=m.user_id AND i.status='ACTIVE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM permission_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND g.subject_id=m.user_id AND g.action='task.read' AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND ((g.resource_kind='ENTERPRISE' AND g.project_id IS NULL AND g.resource_id=m.tenant_id) OR (g.resource_kind='PROJECT' AND g.project_id=#{projectId} AND g.resource_id=#{projectId}) OR (g.resource_kind='TASK' AND g.project_id=#{projectId} AND g.resource_id IS NULL))) ORDER BY m.user_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE task_plan_head SET plan_revision=#{planRevision},revision=#{resultingPlanHeadRevision},updated_at=#{now} WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND plan_revision=#{basePlanRevision} AND revision=#{expectedPlanHeadRevision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_input_revision(project_id,task_id,task_revision,operation_id,document_type,owner_id,goal,based_on_document_revision, request_json,request_sha256,scope_json,scope_sha256,missing_requirements,requirements_sha256,authority_grant,authority_revision, auth_epoch,governance_epoch,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification) VALUES(#{projectId},#{taskId},#{taskRevision},#{operationId},#{documentType},#{ownerId},#{goal},#{basedOnDocumentRevision}, CAST(#{request} AS JSON),#{inputHash},CAST(#{scopeJson} AS JSON),#{scopeHash},CAST(#{requirements} AS JSON),#{requirementsHash}, #{authorityGrant},#{authorityRevision},#{authEpoch},#{governanceEpoch},'1.0.0',#{manifest},#{userId},#{now},#{classification})
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id FROM task_input_revision WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND task_revision=#{taskRevision} AND created_by=#{userId} AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_id=#{taskId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='task.created'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_plan_decision(project_id,task_id,decision_id,operation_id,target_plan_revision,target_plan_sha256,basis_task_revision, resulting_task_revision,resulting_plan_revision,decision,from_status,to_status,expected_revision,resulting_revision,reason, request_json,baseline_manifest,baseline_sha256,dependency_authorizations,receipt_json,receipt_sha256,authority_grant, authority_revision,auth_epoch,governance_epoch,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification) VALUES(#{projectId},#{taskId},#{decisionId},#{operationId},#{basePlanRevision},#{basePlanHash},#{basisTaskRevision}, #{taskRevision},#{resultingPlanRevision},#{decision},#{fromStatus},#{taskStatus},#{expectedRevision},#{resultingRevision},#{reason}, CAST(#{request} AS JSON),CAST(#{baseline} AS JSON),#{baselineHash},CAST(#{authorizations} AS JSON),CAST(#{response} AS JSON), #{responseHash},#{authorityGrant},#{authorityRevision},#{authEpoch},#{governanceEpoch},'1.0.0',#{operationManifest},#{userId},#{now},#{classification})
mapper.select: SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{taskId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resultingRevision} AND event_type=#{action}
